title: K-Means Assignment
statement: Implement `kmeans_assign(points, centroids)`. Return the index of the nearest centroid for each point under Euclidean distance. If two centroids are equally far, choose the smaller index.

approaches.name: Lloyd assignment
approaches.explanation: Lloyd's algorithm alternates this assignment with a mean update.

editorial: K-Means alternates two steps. Assignment gives each point the nearest centroid. Update replaces each centroid with the mean of its points. This exercise is only assignment. Using a strict less-than when you compare distances makes an equal distance keep the earlier centroid, which is the smaller index if you scan left to right. Empty clusters are a separate problem: a later update step must reseed them or the algorithm stalls.
